digest.component_or_area: test subprocess environment handling and traceback security
propositions: 103 non-fixture test subprocess environments constructed from os.environ as ordinary dicts or mapping spreads render inherited credential values in pytest long tracebacks when process startup fails
A mutable dict subclass with redacted __repr__ preserves exact subprocess semantics and child environment values while preventing credential disclosure in default-long traceback rendering
An AST repository-policy guard rejects raw broad environment constructors (dict(os.environ), {**os.environ}, .copy()) and unsafe boundary unwrapping to prevent credential leakage regressions
Seven separately-owned decorated fixtures are structurally excluded from the guard; their own repairs removed the need for temporary exclusions
